advance.road_type_text: Speed 75 mph, road_type = 'rural' -> Table 6B-1 category: rural

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 820 ft. CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 14 posts a 650 ft minimum at 75 mph, but only as part of the Case 27 mandatory speed step-down (75 → 65 mph); this plan has no qualifying reduction, so the federal posted-speed value governs (Sheet 7 Case 11: buffer VARIES per General Note 24).
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance). CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 7 Case 11 (buffer VARIES per General Note 24).

case.case: Case 11 (reduced work-zone speed): Shoulder closure on divided highway
case.narrative: This scenario matches CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11: shoulder closure on a divided highway, with a reduced work-zone posted speed (75 → 70 mph) that does not match the Case 26/27 mandated step-down. Fines Double envelope applies per S-630-1 Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes.
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 75 mph.

checks.detail: Required: True. Signs placed: 16 left, 16 right.
checks.label: Signs on both sides of divided highway
G20-5P Work Zone signs every 2,640 ft

checks.detail: Work-zone speed reduced 75 → 70 mph (Δ5 mph). Required: 1. Placed: 1.
checks.label: Speed reduction <= 15 mph per sign installation

fines_double.citation: CDOT S-630-1 (July 2026) Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes

operational_notes.action: Install Fines Double signs no more than 4 hours before the start of the work day. Do not leave signs up overnight when work is not active.
Remove or cover Fines Double signs when work concludes; doubled fines apply only when workers or work activity are present in the zone.
Relocate the R2-10/R2-11 envelope to follow the actual work area as the project progresses; do not leave Fines Double signs in place beyond the active work zone.
Maintain a 250 ft minimum spacing between Fines Double signs (R2-10, R2-11, G20-5P/R2-6P assemblies) and other warning or regulatory signs. Engineer may adjust placement to satisfy this minimum.

flagger.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Chapter 6D (Flagger Control) and Chapter 6E (One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Control).

spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 15 tangent + 2 downstream = 17 cones total
spacing.in_taper_text: 75 mph -> 75 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 75 mph -> 150 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.tangent_count_text: 2000 ft / 150 ft max spacing -> 15 cones at 142.9 ft intervals
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 250 ft / 75 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 62.5 ft intervals

taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure on divided highway, reduced work-zone speed)
taper.formula_choice: Speed 75 mph >= 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
